bullets.text: Active Exploitation Alert - **Microsoft Defender** identifies ongoing attacks exploiting **SolarWinds Web Help Desk** vulnerabilities.
New Clickfix Variant - The **CrashFix** campaign uses browser crashes to deploy a **Python Remote Access Trojan**.
Microsoft 365 Community Event - Join the **Microsoft 365 Community Conference** in April for insights on intelligent work.
Operation Winter SHIELD - **Microsoft** supports a new initiative to close the security implementation gap in organizations.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New **Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 28020.1546** released with improvements.
Microsoft SDL Update - **Microsoft's Secure Development Lifecycle** evolves to address AI-specific security concerns.
Enhanced Azure Storage - **Azure NetApp Files** introduces Elastic zone-redundant service for improved data resiliency.
AI-Ready PostgreSQL - **Azure** enhances **PostgreSQL** for AI applications, supporting modern developer needs.
Infostealers Targeting macOS - **Microsoft Defender** reports a rise in infostealer threats targeting macOS environments.
